what_this_is: Measured dollars spent in each pattern (cost at stake), from committed Bentham usage. Not a saving; never a Junto score. Only junto.py add-test with two measured arms verifies a saving.

savers.what: Main sessions (Bentham's 'coordinator' rows) that do bounded work themselves, poll GitHub, or carry long turns: delegate bounded tasks to cheaper workers, wait with one background watcher, keep turns short.
savers.test: Two comparable waves on the same route (same claim-kit route, same reviewer setup): one run as before, one with the lean-coordination brief. Compare coordinator plus worker dollars per filed claim, and rejects per attempt (quality must not fall).

savers.what: End a long coordinator context at a phase boundary and continue in a fresh session from the handoff notes (Revere), instead of carrying hundreds of thousands of tokens into every call.
savers.test: Same wave phase run twice: once continuing the long session, once handed off to a fresh session at the phase boundary. Compare coordinator dollars per completed batch.

savers.what: Do not hold a 1-hour prompt cache across long idle waits; let it lapse or end the turn and resume.
savers.test: Two waits of the same length on the same kind of GitHub run: one holding the session, one ending the turn and resuming. Compare dollars per hour of wait.
